key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:6DF0
name: init_entity_with_random_placement
description: Takes three values from an indirect library call to pick a new position and offsets, computes the matching table entry and resets the entity's state flags. It then calls the same routine three times to place the entity.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:6EE0
name: match_stored_cell_and_latch
description: Returns 0 unless a latched state flag is set and the entity is idle. If the coordinates equal the stored cell, a nonzero third argument latches a new state and returns 3, a zero argument returns 2, and mismatched coordinates return 1.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:6F4C
name: advance_timer_and_pick_cell
description: Advances a timer by 2000 up to a cap, derives a table offset from its low byte and selects a random cell within bit-limited ranges. Blocked entries get their two grid slots cleared, while others set a stall counter and call the routine twice.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:71A0
name: process_command_and_bounds_check
description: Decodes a 9-bit command code from the current table entry and checks the target cell against the map bounds and the last command. Codes 3, 21 and 117 update counters or flags, and other codes call a routine and return a status.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:740C
name: move_to_open_adjacent_cell
description: Tries to move the current position one cell in a direction taken from offset tables. If the target is blocked it samples up to three alternative directions at random and moves to the first passable one, otherwise it commits the original step.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:76D8
name: tick_entity_state_machine
description: Advances a per-entity countdown state machine each frame. It picks a speed of 16 or 64 depending on whether the active record matches a fixed reference, handles a delayed start, and when the countdown ends it attempts a move or resets the state.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:7CAC
name: validate_target_cell_passable
description: Returns 1 when the target cell holds an enabled special code or lies inside the map bounds without a blocking flag. Blocked cells either trigger two routine calls or record a state change, and both paths return 0.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:7DA4
name: choose_and_apply_next_step
description: Handles special command codes 3, 21 and 117 for an active entity. Otherwise it builds a bitmask of blocked neighbouring cells, chooses a direction from it with a random factor, and updates the stored position and table pointer.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8188
name: run_timed_movement_cycle
description: Delegates to the step routine when the activity flag is clear. Otherwise it counts down a timer, plays a routine-driven sequence when the timer expires, advances the animation counters and stores the new position, returning the final routine status.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:877C
name: direction_index_between_points
description: Returns zero when the two points coincide. Otherwise it takes the signs and the dominant axis of the offset between them and looks up a direction code in a table.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:883A
name: copy_table_row_to_slot
description: Copies three 16-bit words from a row of a lookup table into a buffer slot chosen by the first argument, with the row offset taken from the second argument scaled by eight. It then calls a routine to flush that slot.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:88BC
name: search_word_then_lookup_byte
description: Scans a 16-bit word list for the given value, then returns a byte from a table at an offset built from the second argument and an indirect library call result. The scan index does not affect the returned value.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:890C
name: reset_entity_tracking_state
description: Sets a count to 36, points eight slots at a sentinel record, clears four counters and fills sixteen bytes with 255. It then copies the start coordinates, picks a table pointer with a random offset and derives an initial timer from a stored position.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8A2C
name: update_cell_keep_top_bits
description: Replaces the low nine bits of the current cell word with a new value while keeping its top two bits. It toggles a parity flag around a routine call and records the new value in the state block.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8A68
name: swap_two_plane_tile_blocks
description: Swaps a 3-by-3 block of 16-bit words between two interleaved planes, stepping by fixed strides per row and column. The plane pointers come from a base pointer in the state block.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8ABC
name: advance_sequence_frame_timer
description: Advances a per-sprite frame counter and reloads its timer when it expires. On expiry it draws a random value, picks a delay of 16 or 6 by comparing a stored position with the threshold 451, and stores two new table pointers.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8BE6
name: shift_entity_slots_between_rows
description: Copies two entity slots and their word and byte records from one row index to another, overwrites the source slots with a sentinel and calls two routines for the new row.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8D28
name: set_state_byte_by_selector
description: Stores the second argument into one of four state bytes chosen by the first argument, where selectors 0, 2, 4 and 6 map to different bytes. Other selectors leave the state unchanged.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8D78
name: store_value_in_bucket_table
description: Returns 0 if the slot already holds the value. Otherwise it moves entries along the bucket chain to make room, records the new value and calls a routine with the bucket index, returning 1.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:8F9A
name: insert_entry_and_rebalance_buckets
description: Decrements a pending count, inserts the value into the bucketed table, then moves entries down the bucket chain and stores a marker equal to the third argument plus 8 in the top bucket.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:90CA
name: remove_entry_from_bucket_table
description: Removes a value from the bucketed table when the slot matches, checking the paired plane if needed. Entries from higher buckets are moved down to refill the gap, the two associated table slots are pointed at a sentinel and the stored entry is cleared.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9234
name: clear_buffer_and_call_library
description: Zeroes a block of 200 longwords and saves the library base taken from the executive base pointer. It then calls a library vector and runs a second vector if the result is zero, otherwise it runs the next routine.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:92A6
name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns. It does no work and is called from one place.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:92AE
name: allocate_record_and_register
description: Allocates a record whose size comes from a stored count and fills its open-state fields. It writes a fixed name tag, looks up a matching entry through library calls, links or creates it, then calls a library vector with two stored values.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:93E8
name: split_command_line_into_argv
description: Copies a command line into a newly allocated buffer and splits it into words at spaces, tabs and line breaks. Double-quoted words keep their spaces and doubled quotes are unescaped, and the word start pointers are stored in a pointer array terminated by a null pointer.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:93EA
name: split_command_line_into_argv
description: Copies a command line into a newly allocated buffer and splits it into words at spaces, tabs and line breaks. Double-quoted words keep their spaces and doubled quotes are unescaped, and the word start pointers are stored in a pointer array terminated by a null pointer.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:95BE
name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most about 32 thousand bytes. The result always ends with a zero byte.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:95C6
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Finds the terminating zero of the destination and copies the source after it, stopping at the given count. It adds a terminator if the source did not end first, and returns the original destination pointer.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:95EA
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies bytes from the source until a zero byte or the count runs out, then fills the rest of the count with zero bytes. It returns the original destination pointer.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:960C
name: open_icon_library_and_link
description: Opens the library named in the global text (icon.library) and looks up a related entry through library calls. If the entry is found, its pointers are stored in the given record, then the library is closed again.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:96BE
name: perform_signed_division
description: Works out whether the result is negative from the signs of the two inputs, calls the unsigned division routine and negates its quotient when the signs differ. It returns the adjusted quotient in the high half and the second input in the low half.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:96C0
name: perform_signed_division
description: Works out whether the result is negative from the signs of the two inputs, calls the unsigned division routine and negates its quotient when the signs differ. It returns the adjusted quotient in the high half and the second input in the low half.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:96E8
name: negate_result_if_first_negative
description: Calls a routine, then negates the value it leaves in the second register when the first input is negative. It returns that value together with the second input.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9702
name: call_helper_and_pair_results
description: Calls a routine and returns a 64-bit value built from the original second input and the value the routine leaves in the second register. It does no other work.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:970E
name: stub_self_call_only
description: Calls the routine it is in and then returns, with no other work. The decompiled body is a self-reference, so it does nothing useful.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9718
name: divide_unsigned_longwords
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by a divisor. Divisors above 16 bits use a bit-by-bit shift-subtract loop, smaller ones use 16-bit division and remainder steps, and the quotient and remainder are packed into one 64-bit result.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9768
name: run_optional_hook_then_call
description: Calls an optional hook routine stored in a global pointer when that pointer is set. It then forwards its argument to a second routine.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9786
name: release_entries_and_buffers
description: Releases the stored entry records and their table buffer in turn, runs an optional shutdown hook and frees any remaining buffers that are set. It finishes with a final library call when one is set.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:989C
name: close_indexed_entry
description: Closes the entry at the given index, returning -1 and recording an error code when the index is out of range or the slot is empty. Otherwise it releases the stored handle unless its flag bit is set, clears the slot and returns zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:98F2
name: multiply_longwords_truncated
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products and keeps only the low 32 bits of the product. That value is returned in the high half of a 64-bit result with the second input in the low half.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9916
name: tail_call_dos_close
description: Jumps through the DOS library's Close vector using the stored library base, passing the caller's arguments unchanged. It is a thin wrapper with no other logic.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9932
name: tail_call_dos_delete_file
description: Jumps through the DOS library's DeleteFile vector using the stored library base, passing the caller's arguments unchanged. It is a thin wrapper with no other logic.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:9956

description: Jumps through the DOS library's Open vector using the stored library base, passing the caller's arguments unchanged. It is a thin wrapper with no other logic.

description: Jumps through the DOS library's Write vector using the stored library base, passing the caller's arguments unchanged. It is a thin wrapper with no other logic.

description: Loads a library base from a global pointer and jumps through the library function at a fixed offset, passing the arguments unchanged. It is a thin wrapper with no other logic.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:l/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: scan_disk_bitmap_bits
description: Program entry of the disk validator that writes two digit characters into a text line, fills a table of bitmap words with all ones and loops over bitmap bits comparing flags and updating counters. Only part of the listing is visible, so the full result is not confirmed.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:s/SKID_ROW:0:0000
name: write_output_on_nonzero_result
description: Runs a first routine and, when its result is nonzero, calls a second routine and writes through the DOS library's Write vector. It then calls a closing routine before returning.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:s/SKID_ROW:0:0034
name: open_dos_library
description: Calls the exec library's OldOpenLibrary vector to open dos.library and stores the returned library base in a global.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:s/SKID_ROW:0:0060
name: get_dos_output_handle
description: Calls the DOS library's Output vector through the stored DOS base and saves the returned output handle in a global.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:0000
name: allocate_and_tag_block
description: Calls a library vector to obtain a block. When the block is not null it stores the first argument at an offset inside it and calls a second library vector, returning whether a block was obtained.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:0050
name: allocate_and_tag_block
description: Calls a library vector to obtain a block. When the block is not null it stores the first argument at an offset inside it and calls a second library vector, returning whether a block was obtained.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:0080
name: open_libraries_and_init_list
description: Opens two system libraries and, when both succeed, initialises an empty list header in the supplied block and returns that block. On failure it closes whatever was opened, releases the block and returns zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:017A
name: release_unused_list_entries
description: Walks a list of entries, unlinks every entry whose use count is below one and calls a library vector to release it. When no users remain it closes the libraries, unlinks the header and returns its stored value, otherwise it marks the header as pending and returns zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:01D2
name: release_list_header_when_idle
description: When the header has no users and no pending entries, it closes two libraries, frees the header, unlinks it from its list and returns the stored value. Otherwise it sets the pending flag and returns zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:023A
name: mark_header_pending_release
description: Sets the top bit of a flags byte in the header and returns zero. It marks the header to be released later.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:0244
name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the top bit of a flags byte at a fixed offset in the header and increments a short counter at another offset.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:0:0252
name: decrement_counter_and_release
description: Decrements a short counter in the library base. When the counter is still nonzero and the pending bit is set it calls a library vector and returns its result, otherwise it returns zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:5:0000
name: compute_signed_difference_score
description: Computes a signed score from the difference between two 16-bit values, then for seven bit positions in two byte arrays subtracts a global table entry wherever the bits differ. The adjusted score is returned.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:5:00E0
name: find_highest_scoring_font_entry
description: Locks the FONTS: directory and reads a table of 260-byte records from the font file. It scans the table for the entry with the highest score, updates that entry's flags and counters, links it into the font list and frees its scratch buffers before returning the matched pointer.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0000
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from the source to the destination one at a time, up to and including the zero terminator.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0010
name: call_helper_at_string_end
description: Advances to the zero terminator of the string and passes that end pointer and the second argument to a routine.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0022
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It only forwards control and does no other work.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0030
name: count_string_length
description: Counts the characters before the zero terminator and returns that count.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0040
name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns minus one when the first differing byte of the first string is smaller, one when it is larger, and zero when the strings are equal.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0056
name: compare_bytes_return_sign
description: Compares the byte before one pointer with the byte at another pointer and returns minus one if the first is smaller, otherwise one. It works on values passed in registers.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0068
name: find_char_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for the given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or null if it is not found.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:007C
name: find_next_matching_char
description: Starts one byte after the given pointer and scans forward for the byte in the low part of the data register. It returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the terminator is reached first.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0080
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero with no other effect. The routine is a fixed-return stub.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:0084
name: find_last_char_occurrence
description: Measures the string length and scans backwards from the end to find the last occurrence of a byte. It returns a pointer to that byte, or null when the byte is absent.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:7:00B6
name: locate_path_separator
description: Searches the string for a slash and, failing that, for a colon. It returns the pointer to the first separator found, or the input pointer when neither character is present.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:0000
name: collect_font_entries_into_buffer
description: Fills a caller buffer with variable-length font records, copying names from the existing list when flag bit 1 is set and scanning the font directory for more entries when flag bit 2 is set. It returns the shortfall in bytes when the buffer overflows, otherwise zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:005A
name: copy_list_then_scan_directory
description: Copies names from a linked list of font records into the buffer, filling in each record's type and flags. When the second flag bit is set it then scans the font directory, returning the shortfall in bytes when the buffer overflows.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:007E
name: copy_name_then_scan_directory
description: Copies name bytes into the buffer one at a time and, when the record list is exhausted and the second flag bit is set, runs the directory scan. It returns the shortfall in bytes.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:00B8
name: scan_font_directory_entries
description: When the second flag bit is set, locks the font directory and reads 260-byte entries whose names end in .font, appending matching records to the buffer. Temporary buffers are released afterwards and the shortfall in bytes is returned.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:018A
name: read_font_entry_records
description: Reads 260-byte font descriptor records from an open directory and appends each record whose header word matches. The scan moves through the entries until none remain and returns the shortfall in bytes.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:01AA
name: parse_font_name_lines
description: Copies characters from a read buffer into a name field one at a time, emitting a record each time a name reaches its recorded length. It refills the input through the DOS Read vector and returns the shortfall in bytes.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:01E6
name: finish_font_file_parsing
description: Finishes parsing a font file by reading the remaining 260-byte entries and appending those with a matching header word. When the file is exhausted it closes the handle through the DOS Close vector and returns the shortfall in bytes.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:0246
name: release_scan_locks_and_memory
description: Unlocks the directory lock, restores the current directory and frees the temporary buffer. It then returns the shortfall in bytes.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:3:0272
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero immediately without any other operation, so it is a fixed-result stub.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:1:0000
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It only forwards control and does no other work.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:libs/Diskfont.library:1:0012
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It only forwards control and does no other work.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:0000
name: copy_string_into_global_buffer
description: Copies a counted string from the source pointer into a fixed global buffer and writes a terminator after it. It then calls two routines and returns zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:0040
name: free_buffer_and_set_status
description: When the low byte of the data register is non-negative, it calls a routine, sets a status global to 15 and frees a block through the exec library's FreeMem vector. It returns zero in both cases.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:006E
name: save_state_and_enable_interrupts
description: Saves the previous value of the interrupt control register, stores a new vector address and writes the master-enable and interrupt-enable bits. Interrupts are enabled as a result.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:0094
name: restore_saved_interrupt_state
description: Writes back the interrupt-control value saved earlier and then writes the enable bits to the interrupt control register again.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:00B0
name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Calls a routine when bit 5 of the interrupt request status is set, then enters an empty endless loop. The routine never returns.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:00D6
name: open_read_and_close_file
description: Opens dos.library and then a file through the DOS Open vector. When the handle is valid it reads from it and closes it again, using the exec OldOpenLibrary and CloseLibrary vectors for the library.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:0148
name: initialise_pointer_table
description: Builds a table of 15 longword pointers by accumulating offsets read from a source table at a fixed memory address. It clears the words each pointer refers to, toggles a flag and clears several state words.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:01B4
name: advance_step_and_update_channels
description: Advances a step counter and, at the cycle boundary, resets it, recomputes a table pointer, waits in a short delay loop and writes output words for each flagged source. Between boundaries it only calls routines for the flagged sources.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:0226
name: apply_channel_effect_step
description: Runs one effect step on a channel record. Depending on the effect code it lowers or raises the period, kept between 113 and 856, or adjusts the volume capped at 64, and otherwise returns unchanged.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:02F2
name: add_volume_with_cap
description: Adds the data-register word to a channel level field, caps the result at 64 and copies it into the channel's volume slot.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:0312
name: subtract_volume_with_floor
description: Subtracts a masked parameter from a channel level field, floors the result at zero and copies it into the channel's volume slot.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:04C0
name: advance_position_with_wrap
description: Sets a position from the low byte of the data register shifted left by seven, plus sixteen. When the position reaches 1024 it resets to zero and advances a table index, wrapping at its limit.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:04FC
name: update_channel_from_sequence_entry
description: Loads the next sequence entry for a channel by copying a pointer and length from a source table and adding a stored offset. When the entry names an instrument it updates the channel's sample address and length, then applies the period and volume effect, with code 15 setting a speed and code 12 setting volume directly.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:4:0:0718
name: halt_if_key_code_nine
description: If the stored byte equals the character nine and its top bit is clear, it opens intuition.library by name and then loops forever calling a library vector. Otherwise it returns.

name: parse_startup_command_arguments
description: Program entry that allocates a process record and parses its argument text into words, unescaping quoted text and the star-N and star-E escape codes. It then either takes the CLI command line or waits for a Workbench message, calls a routine and releases its resources before returning.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:0:01A0
name: release_handles_and_free_state
description: Stores the given value in the process record, closes an open file handle and library, and when a message record is present calls two exec vectors to forbid and reply. It then frees the record and returns the saved value.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:0000
name: prepare_icon_render_buffer
description: Looks up dimensions through the icon.library entries, allocates a 1536-byte block and fills it with a pattern for each plane, then copies the result with a block copy. It reports a message when allocation fails.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:021C
name: dispatch_icon_request_command
description: Builds a command line in a buffer and, for a single-dot response, appends the parameters and issues a follow-up call that depends on flags. The routine references the text WAIT >NIL: 999 min and endcli >NIL:, the command forms it sends.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:0382
name: initialise_library_and_enable
description: Creates a library from the given structure, adds its function table with the second and third arguments and enables it. It returns the result of the final call.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:03DE
name: build_icon_path_from_list
description: Walks a linked list of name entries and appends each printable name to a path string with separators. It replaces the first slash with a colon and falls back to RAM: when no name was found, then frees its 260-byte scratch buffer and returns the path length.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:050E
name: join_three_string_arguments
description: Calls routines on three string arguments in turn, using the length returned by one routine to find the end of the joined text, and then calls another routine there.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:0554
name: count_string_length
description: Counts the bytes before the zero terminator and returns that count.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:0564
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from the source to the destination one at a time, up to and including the zero terminator.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:0574
name: call_helper_at_string_end
description: Advances to the zero terminator of the string and passes that end pointer and the second argument to a routine.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:2:0590
name: parse_signed_decimal_value
description: Parses an optional leading plus or minus sign followed by decimal digits from a string and returns the signed integer value.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:5:0000
name: call_with_stack_slot_argument
description: Calls another routine with its two arguments and a pointer to a stack slot as a third argument, then returns.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:4:0000
name: format_text_into_stack_buffer
description: Calls the exec library's RawDoFmt vector through a global pointer to format text into a 140-byte stack buffer. It measures the formatted length and, when that length is nonzero, passes the buffer and length to a routine.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:4:0050
name: call_raw_format_vector
description: Jumps through the exec library's RawDoFmt vector using the stored base, passing the caller's arguments unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:c/IconX:4:0074
name: store_byte_at_output_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address held in the address register and returns. It is a single byte store, the usual shape of a character output callback.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:0:0000
name: run_main_frame_loop
description: Program entry that sets a colour register and the DMA enable bits, then runs a frame loop. The loop advances a frame counter, updates timers and checks the joystick button until its limits are reached.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:0000
name: save_and_reset_chip_interrupts
description: Saves the DMA, interrupt and audio-control register values into the state block, then disables all interrupts. It installs two handler addresses and re-enables the interrupt bits it needs.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:00C4
name: restore_chip_state_from_block
description: Writes the saved chip state back to the DMA, interrupt and audio control registers, with interrupts disabled first and the enable bits set afterwards.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:0160
name: open_console_and_report_errors
description: Saves two state words and opens a console window through the DOS Open vector. It then uses the DOS Write and Close vectors on it and, when an error flag is set, reports through a stored output routine and a library vector.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:0214
name: tail_call_exec_free_mem
description: Jumps through the exec library's FreeMem vector using the stored base, passing the caller's arguments unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:0228
name: drive_port_around_helper_calls
description: Writes a port value, calls a routine, writes a second value and calls the routine again, then writes the first value back. The port is driven around the routine calls.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:0288
name: load_assets_run_frame_loop
description: Opens graphics.library, reads resource data through DOS and allocates memory, then runs the frame loop. The loop sets a colour register and the DMA enable bits, advances a frame counter and checks the joystick button until its limits are reached.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:06EA
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It only forwards control and does no other work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:075E
name: advance_timed_sequence_step
description: Advances a step counter unless the disable flag is set. At two fixed step values it sets a value and calls a routine, and at a later step it calls a stored function pointer once and sets a flag.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:07D4
name: find_entry_near_point
description: Scans a table of 22-byte entries and counts those whose position falls inside a small window around a reference point. It records the index of the first qualifying entry in a result word.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:0896
name: update_flag_from_bit_two
description: Stores a fixed word in the record and sets a global flag to all ones when bit two of a status byte is clear, otherwise zero. It then calls two routines and stores the second result in a global.

name: increase_value_to_limit

name: draw_text_glyphs_to_bitplanes
description: Renders a byte string of glyphs into four bitplanes until the end marker of 255. Each character selects a 16-row glyph from a table and copies or masks its bits into the planes, advancing one column per character; code 26 steps back one column.
